name: append in recursion pre order
code:
def f(n, out):
    if n == 0:
        return
    out.append(n)
    f(n - 1, out)
out = []
f(3, out)
print(out)

name: append in recursion post order
code:
def g(n, out):
    if n == 0:
        return
    g(n - 1, out)
    out.append(n)
out = []
g(3, out)
print(out)

name: append in nested function
code:
def h(out):
    def inner():
        out.append(1)
    inner()
    return out
o = []
print(h(o), o)

name: global list append in recursion
code:
acc = []
def r(n):
    if n == 0:
        return
    acc.append(n)
    r(n - 1)
r(3)
print(acc)
